sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Ilia is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. She is the "Oracle Maiden" and the love interest of Ark.

sections.title: Debut Appearance
sections.content:
Ark mentioned Ilia's name for the first time in Bariura, after Summoner defeated Lucius.

Ilia made her debut physically after Ark broke the seal of Karna Masta's soul in Mildran.

sections.title: In the storyline
sections.content: Before Ilia became the Oracle Maiden, she lived with her parents and her older brother. But then she was taken to be a candidate of the Oracle Maiden. One day, after she became the Oracle Maiden, she received a revelation that Karna Masta will annihilate humanity. Lucius then ordered her and a knight who was assigned to protect her to defeat the Holy Emperor. The order then turned out to be a part of Lucius' nasty plan, as the God of Gate ordered one of His disciples to take Ilia as a hostage, since her power as Oracle Maiden was necessary to seal Karna Masta in Ishgria. Since then, Ilia remained imprisoned in Mildran until Ark and Summoner rescued her and defeated Karna Masta's soul.

sections.title: Balgran
sections.content: Balgran is Ilia's late older brother.

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content:
- Ilia almost has the exact appearance as the Unit, Maria, whom often mistaken by players and fans alike.
- Ilia was first seen in the title screen of Brave Frontier when it was first released, along with Ark and Karna Masta.
- According to Brave Frontier Storybook:
- She was born on May 24
- Her height is 160 cm.
- Her weight is 45 kg.
- Her 3-size is 86-61-86 (in cm).
